notes: Formulation `b` enforces the travel-time limit directly with $T_{ij} y_{ij} \leq T_{\text{limit}}$, so it has no counterpart for the feasibility indicator $\delta$ of formulation `a`; the map drops it and carries every other parameter across unchanged.
Dropping $\delta$ loses no information: formulation `a` assumes $\delta_{ij} = 1 \iff T_{ij} \leq T_{\text{limit}}$, so $\delta$ is recoverable from $T$ and $T_{\text{limit}}$.
